policy.teamSampling: ordered four-slot canonical-role sampling with replacement; candidate teams are unique
policy.roleSkills: canonical role kit only in V1
policy.knowledgeInput: all renderer-visible combat signals; hidden design metadata is excluded
policy.declarativeAudit: battle information parser at ordinary perception
policy.vectorRule: opponent-local percentile -> six-context aggregation -> top-30-percent zero boundary
policy.queryRule: natural-language requirement direction dot unnormalized team cognition vector
policy.rawSignalStorage: streamed into summaries; only compact audit evidence is persisted

axes.label: 伤害
axes.description: 持续对敌人造成总体战斗伤害并压低敌方生命

axes.label: 保护
axes.description: 通过治疗和护盾保护队友并让队伍存活

axes.label: 增益
axes.description: 强化队友并放大全队能力

axes.label: 启动
axes.description: 快速启动并在战斗前期形成有效压力

axes.label: 爆发
axes.description: 在很短时间内集中造成大量爆发伤害

axes.label: 持续伤害
axes.description: 依靠毒、灼烧或稳定输出长时间磨掉敌人生命

axes.label: 群体伤害
axes.description: 同时攻击多个敌人并快速清理成群目标

axes.label: 控制
axes.description: 减速、冻结或限制敌人行动，为队伍争取时间

axes.label: 单点处决
axes.description: 集中攻击危险目标并快速完成单点击杀
